import os
from pathlib import Path


def inspect(root: Path, descriptor: int) -> tuple[bool, bool, str, object]:
    os.fchdir(descriptor)
    os.lchmod(root, 0o600)
    os.umask(0o077)
    drives = (
        os.listdrives(),
        os.listvolumes(),
        os.listmounts("volume"),
        os.path.isdevdrive(root),
    )
    return (
        root.is_junction(),
        os.path.isjunction(root),
        root.with_segments("state").read_text(),
        drives,
    )
